run_comparison_cli: run the comparison CLI tool to export experiment results from a directory as CSV or XML
create_experiment_results: create an ExperimentResults object to parse network parameters, complexity, and quality metrics from an experiment directory
read_quality_info: read a quality CSV file and compute mean, min, max stats for MSE, PSNR, SSIM, and FLIP metrics
build_csv_printer: build a CSVComparisonPrinter to format experiment results into CSV rows with all metrics and video data
build_xml_printer: build an XMLComparisonPrinter to format experiment results into XML elements with all metrics and video data
